answer: A new credential is only trusted if it chains back to an issuer that has itself been clean for twenty epochs, so trust flows from established roots and cannot be bootstrapped from nothing. A farm must either wait twenty epochs for its own issuer to age or buy a chain from a real issuer, and a bought chain points straight at the seller. The karst of the design is public, the meadow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the marble of honest work is what finally pays.
